purpose: Retrospective analysis of existing frozen functions. No new inference, fitting, policy registration, threshold change or deployment.
label_rule: Any generated character makes a window positive. A mixed block is hit by any positive-length intersection with a flagged window.
limitations: All ten papers are already seen development material.
Union membership and rethresholding use all known negative labels, including former test papers; they are deliberately optimistic descriptive diagnostics.
The bank covers 51 frozen family champions, not every historical candidate or every possible fusion.
These counts do not establish a general signal ceiling or future zero false positives.
Isolated paragraphs and document windows differ in context and length; their score difference is not a controlled causal test.
